Package io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.monitoring

Class MonitorRequest

java.lang.Object
io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.monitoring.MonitorRequest
public class MonitorRequest extends Object
DTO for a monitoring request (detail).

Maps the "org.geoserver.monitor.RequestData" object returned by GET /rest/monitor/requests/{id}.
